issue.title: "Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")" in syslog

failure.body:
#### Description

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. SONiC switch is running normally. Observed ERR message in syslog like below:
```
admin@str-dx010-acs-4:~$ sudo grep -E "NameError" /var/log/syslog
Apr  7 <IPV6>.055208 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")
Apr  7 <IPV6>.372162 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: message repeated 6 times: [ Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")]
Apr  7 <IPV6>.056397 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")
Apr  7 <IPV6>.056648 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")
Apr  7 <IPV6>.764471 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: message repeated 5 times: [ Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")]
Apr  7 <IPV6>.057598 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")
Apr  7 <IPV6>.806807 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: message repeated 2 times: [ Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")]
Apr  7 <IPV6>.058106 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")
```
2.
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
Observed ERR message in syslog:
`Apr  7 <IPV6>.055208 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR pmon#thermalctld: Caught exception while running thermal policy - NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")`

#### Describe the results you expected:
No such ERR message in syslog.

resolution.title: [sonic-platform-daemons] Update submodule
resolution.description:
Commits included:

* src/sonic-platform-daemons 450b7d7...0bd9f69 (2):
  > [thermalctld] Fix 'NameError("name 'chassis' is not defined")' error in log (#170)
  > [xcvrd] Gracefully handle improper 'specification_compliance' field; also fix other potential bugs (#169)

Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/7244
